title: Easy Vegetable Stir-Fry with Creamy Peanut Sauce
style: Quick, colorful stir-fry with a creamy, nutty peanut sauce
description: A vibrant stir-fry of fresh vegetables and noodles tossed in a creamy, flavorful peanut sauce — ready in under 30 minutes.

items.note: fresh or frozen, e.g., broccoli, carrots, cauliflower

steps: Prep Ingredients: Chop onion, garlic, ginger, snow peas, and baby corn. Thaw any frozen vegetables. Cook noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Make the Peanut Sauce: In a bowl, mix peanut butter, soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, water, maple syrup, and lemongrass (if using) until creamy.
Cook the Stir-Fry: Heat oil in a wok or large pan until shimmering. Add garlic, ginger, onion, snow peas, and baby corn; stir-fry for 40 seconds.
Add remaining vegetables and stir-fry 4–5 minutes until tender but crisp.
Combine Sauce & Noodles: Reduce heat slightly. Add peanut sauce and noodles to the pan, tossing to coat evenly. If needed, add a splash more water to loosen the sauce.
Stir in peanuts and cook 3–5 more minutes until everything is heated through and glossy. Remove lemongrass before serving.
Serve: Plate immediately, finishing with optional peanuts, fresh herbs, lime wedges, or chili oil for extra punch.
tips: Glass noodles absorb the sauce beautifully; soak or cook as directed for best texture.
Toast peanuts beforehand for extra crunch and aroma.
You can swap vegetables freely — just maintain similar cook times to keep crisp-tender texture.
Add a small drizzle of lime juice at the end for brightness and balance.
